title.zh: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
title.en: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping

current_state.zh: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic said they will adopt a shared 'policy token' standard that lets publishers express AI training and scraping preferences across multiple AI companies at once instead of configuring opt-outs company by company.
current_state.en: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic said they will adopt a shared 'policy token' standard that lets publishers express AI training and scraping preferences across multiple AI companies at once instead of configuring opt-outs company by company.
